name: normalCounterHurt
description: Calculates counter-attack damage. Uses counter_dam multiplier and counter_def resistance. Only applies pierce/block (calArmorAndBlock), not suppress/inspire.

parameters.usePierceResist: boolean, default true — whether to apply pierce/block

formula_steps.formula: ATK = attacker.att, DEF = defender.def, DEF_COE = defender.def_coe

formula_steps.description: Calculate base damage with defense coefficient
Get counter resistance with optional pierce/block

formula_steps.formula: dmg = roundInt(baseDmg * counter_dam) * round(1 - resistance), dmg = roundInt(dmg)
if (crit_flag != 1): dmg = roundInt(dmg * max(1.5, round(crit_dam / crit_def)))

simplified_formula: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * counter_dam * round(1 - pierce_block(counter_def))), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
